property_summary: After staking 100 tokens as user address(0xb0b), balanceOf(address(0xb0b)) returns 100 in reference but _totalSupply (100) in mutant; then adding rewardToken (address(1)) and calling balanceOf(address(0xb0b)) still returns 100 in reference but _totalSupply (100) in mutant (same), but assertEqual fails because reference returns _balances[account] which is 100, mutant returns _totalSupply which is also 100 — actually they are equal. Need a case where _balances[account] != _totalSupply: after staking, reference balanceOf(user) = staked amount, mutant = _totalSupply which is same as staked amount — no divergence. Correct divergence: after staking 100 and then another user staking 50, reference balanceOf(firstUser) = 100, mutant = _totalSupply = 150. So assertEq(c.balanceOf(firstUser), 100) passes on reference, fails on mutant (returns 150).
